notes: Fresh genesis: enrollmentRoot=0x1b49e706…3cd84 (canonical depth-20 pedersen zero-tree), leafCount=0. OPRF service DB wiped to match at cutover.

supersedes_within_sepolia.reason: Superseded by user-direct clean-slate redeploy on 2026-05-29 — user wanted leaf #1 in a fresh tree to test the post-#55/#50 enrollment flow end-to-end. Prior deploy had backend's e2e enrollments + the sealed demo signature 0x9ea18325…7504 (preserved on-chain as historical artifact; live demo signature on the new EnrollmentRegistry will be captured fresh).

Initial Sepolia deploy used V2_GENESIS_ROOT=bytes32(0), which mismatched the OPRF service's canonical depth-20 zero-tree root 0x1b49e706…3cd84 → every attester sig recovered to wrong address → BadSignature(). Redeployed with V2_GENESIS_ROOT set to the pedersen-zero-tree root.
